articles.summary: This release introduces Intelligent Inventory Merchandising, Ekho’s AI system that automatically matches and enriches client inventory from dealers, dealer groups, OEMs, and marketplaces to power both the AI Sales Agent and the Transaction Engine. By identifying, normalizing, and merchandising vehicles, even with inconsistent source data, the platform eliminates manual inventory mapping, accelerates onboarding, improves vehicle discovery, gives the AI Sales Agent deeper knowledge of every vehicle, and powers autonomous titling and registration. Clients benefit from faster processing, better search performance, and better-informed buyer conversations, while buyers experience a smoother path from research to road-ready.
articles.title: Intelligent Inventory Merchandising is Live
